column1: # Sync / power-on log texts (#139): one line per ring event. Generated into C by scripts/gen_awto_sync.py; the host decoder
# (awto-ddc scripts/sync_log.py, rtd_diag.py --sync) reads this file, so screen and host print the same line.
# id: event id (hex). Mirrored switch-log ids (RL6449_Project.h AWTO_SW_EV_*): 10 panel requests, 11 / 12 panel machine, 90 probe,
#   A0 fast path, A8 hold, B0 / B1 HPD pulse; 13 / 14 system machine transition / request (#162 step 3), 1C power LED (#95), 15..18 their name
#   tables (state, who / why, request, outcome, 19 separators, 1A mode text per state, 1B panel requester: looked up by the
#   sys / sysreq / pby fmts, never logged themselves). Own ids C0..CF (AWTO_SYNC_EV_*; CB..CF = #144 power-saving wake).
#   Only rows listed here are logged (mirror filter). One fact = one line (#162 s3b): no row for an event a machine line
#   already states (switch-log mode 01, pin edges 10 00..03, panel stage D1 05/07/08, probes 90 01/0E, A0 00/05, A8 01..09, C9).
# arg: hex value, or * = any (first matching row wins: put * rows last).
# fmt: how the event's value / arg is printed at the % in text:
#   -     no value          port  "Dn " prefix from arg (port byte, D0 = 3)     vport  value = port byte -> "Dn" (0xFF = auto)
#   res   value = H << 16 | V -> "3840x2160"          mhz1  value in 0.1 MHz -> "594.0 MHz"     hz1  value in 0.1 Hz -> "60.0 Hz"
#   hz3   value in mHz -> "59.997 Hz"                 mhz3  value in kHz -> "594.000 MHz"       dp   value = rate << 8 | lanes -> "HBR2 x4"
#   src   value = SDK source type -> "HDMI"           harg  arg in hex
#   pc    value = cause << 24 | bank << 16 | PC -> "STALL, PC 0B:FFD0" (#29 boot reason)
#   ms    value in ms -> "12 ms" (#150)   n  value as a number (#150)   x  value in hex (#150)
#   Texts may hold {NAME} or {NAME/DIV} = integer #define in RL6449_Project.h, resolved at generation and in the host copy.
#   sys   arg = old << 4 | new state, value = why << 24 | ms in old -> "OFF -> INITIAL (5230 ms): POWER key"; why bit 7 =
#         the SDK mode changed: "; " + the new state's mode text (table 1A) is appended (#162 s3b: the old mode line's text)
#   sysreq arg = request, value = who << 8 | outcome -> "power off requested by POWER key (accepted)"
#   pby   value = panel requester (table 1B) -> "boot (cold power-up: panel early)" (#162 s3b)
#   sname value = system state (table 15) -> "ACTIVE" (#95 LED line)
#   ms2   two % marks: value = second ms << 16 | first ms -> "87 ms" ... "32 ms" (#162 s3b; low word = ms in the old state)
#   wdt   value = warning ms << 16 | reset ms -> "warning 200 ms, reset 586 ms" (live from AWTO_WDT_THR / AWTO_WDT_N)
#   htime value = unix s, arg = UTC offset (15 min, signed) -> "2026-11-12T08:45:10+11:00" (#157)   sms  signed ms -> "+1234 ms" (#157)
#   nvw   NVRAM flush result (#151, RL6449_Project.h AWTO_NV_LOG_*): value = groups << 27 | erases << 25 | programs << 19 |
#         bytes << 9 | ms -> "wrote 32 B (OSD data, panel time) in 2 programs, 0 erases, 4 ms" / "nothing changed, no flash write (3 ms)"
# A fmt with a port prefix is written port+<fmt> (port prefix from arg, value from the value).
# Width: the console log wraps a line to a second row (under the text); gen_awto_sync.py fails a row whose worst case needs 3.
# Machine lines read "<machine>: OLD -> NEW (N ms): what", N ms = the time in OLD.
